title: Retrospective report of a Welkite water-scarcity demonstration dated 14 January 2023; event details contested

event_type: Reported public demonstration involving jerry-cans over potable-water scarcity; retrospective account.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The retrospective article provides no verified count of simultaneous physical attendees at a single site.

start_date.paraphrase: The April retrospective dates the Welkite demonstration to 14 January 2023. This is an attributed retrospective date; casualty references in the same article are ambiguous with a distinct February episode.

location.paraphrase: The article identifies Welkite town in Guraghe but not the exact assembly site.

event_type.paraphrase: The account describes people carrying jerry-cans during a demonstration associated with potable-water scarcity.

demand_status.paraphrase: Water scarcity is the reported grievance. The article’s broader discussion of Guraghe self-administration does not establish it as this gathering’s own direct state-directed demand; no demand category is coded.

response_status.paraphrase: No response or casualty is assigned to the January gathering. The retrospective’s shooting/death passage cites February reporting, while the separate VOA account describes a February event in Welkite with differing casualty accounts.
